title: Elysia product search with cursor
context: Product search on bun:sqlite ordered by id. q matches as a substring of name and LIKE wildcards (% and _) in q must match literally. The cursor is the last id of the previous page; nextCursor is returned only when more rows exist after this page.
code: const db = new Database("catalog.db", { readonly: true });
.query(`SELECT id, name, price FROM products WHERE ${where.join(" AND ")} ORDER BY id LIMIT ?`)
.all(...args, limit) as { id: number; name: string; price: number }[];
const nextCursor = rows.length === limit ? rows[rows.length - 1].id : null;

expected.why: SQLite LIKE has no default escape character, so the backslash escapes do nothing without ESCAPE '\\'
category is interpolated into the SQL text (injection); it must be a bound parameter
when exactly `limit` rows remain it returns a cursor to an empty page; fetch limit + 1 rows to know if more exist
